questions.question: In synchronous digital integrated circuit design, what does the setup time (t_su) of an edge-triggered flip-flop fundamentally specify?
options: The minimum continuous duration that the data input must remain stable prior to the active clock edge.
The minimum continuous duration that the data input must remain stable following the active clock edge.
The propagation delay from the triggering clock transition to the valid appearance of data at the Q output.
The maximum permissible difference in clock arrival times between the launching and capturing flip-flops.
The minimum pulse width required for the clock signal to reliably activate the internal master latch.

questions.question: In multi-voltage domain digital IC design, why is an up-level shifter strictly required when routing a logic signal from a low-voltage supply domain (VDDL) to a high-voltage supply domain (VDDH)?
options: To prevent hot-carrier injection (HCI) degradation caused by overdriving the low-voltage output driver.
To prevent static crowbar (short-circuit) current in the receiving gate caused by the VDDL high level failing to fully turn off the PMOS pull-up network.
To eliminate transmission line reflections caused by characteristic impedance mismatches between the two power islands.
To compensate for dynamic clock jitter and duty-cycle distortion generated across the dissimilar power distribution networks.
To prevent forward biasing of the electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection diodes located inside the low-voltage cell.

questions.question: In Network-on-Chip (NoC) architectures, how does the introduction of virtual channels fundamentally resolve routing deadlocks caused by cyclic buffer dependencies?
options: By dynamically adjusting flit packet lengths to ensure no packet spans multiple intermediate router hops.
By converting wormhole-switched flits into store-and-forward packets upon detecting heavy downstream network congestion.
By multiplexing multiple logically independent FIFO buffers over a shared physical link, allowing unblocked packets in one buffer to bypass stalled packets in another.
By discarding stalled packets and initiating an end-to-end negative acknowledgment (NACK) retransmission protocol.
By enforcing strict time-division multiplexed (TDM) link arbitration across all physical network links.

questions.question: In computer memory hierarchy design, what is the primary architectural purpose and operational benefit of a Victim Cache?
options: A direct-mapped prefetch buffer located ahead of the L1 instruction cache to stream non-branching instruction blocks.
A dedicated FIFO write buffer that holds modified blocks awaiting writeback to main memory to hide DRAM precharge latency.
A bus snooping filter placed at the interconnect boundary to drop unnecessary cache-invalidation requests.
A small, fully associative cache placed between the L1 cache and the next cache level to store recently evicted L1 blocks and reduce conflict misses.
A software-managed scratchpad memory designed to hold spilled register contents across processor context switches.

questions.question: In standard 6T SRAM bitcell design, how is read stability ensured to prevent a 'read disturb' (destructive read) from accidentally flipping the stored state when the wordline is asserted?
options: By precharging the bitlines to ground (VSS) so that discharge current cannot enter the internal storage nodes.
By sizing the access NMOS transistors to have a significantly higher transconductance than the pull-down NMOS driver transistors.
By driving the wordline to a voltage strictly lower than the bitline precharge voltage during read operations.
By sizing the pull-up PMOS transistors wider than the access NMOS transistors to continuously outdrive incoming bitline charge.
By sizing the pull-down NMOS driver transistors stronger than the access NMOS transistors (Cell Ratio > 1) to keep the internal low node below the opposing inverter's trip voltage.
